items.verdict: 2.3° apart at 20:32, 20° and 18° up, Moon 6% lit.

items.title: First Quarter
items.verdict: Moon sets near local midnight; the second half of the night is moon-free.

items.title: Orionids
items.verdict: ZHR ~20. Radiant up 01:58–05:03, highest 32.4° at 05:03. 83% moon in the way for part of it — usable 04:48–05:03. Active 10-02 – 11-07. A better night inside the active range: 10-18, 98 min moonless with the radiant up. Halley's Comet debris; fast meteors. IMO 2026 calendar gives the maximum as October 21 at solar longitude 208° with no hour, and rates can hold for several nights around it; peak_utc is when the Sun reaches 208.0° (J2000).

items.title: Leonis Minorids
items.verdict: ZHR ~2. Below horizon here — the radiant never clears 10° during astronomical darkness. Active 10-19 – 10-27. Very sparse; listed so a stray meteor near Leo Minor is not mistaken for an Orionid.

items.title: Southern Taurids
items.verdict: ZHR ~5. Radiant up 22:10–04:40, highest 35.9° at 02:15. 17% moon in the way for part of it — usable 22:10–04:25. Active 09-23 – 11-12. 2026 is a minor Taurid resonant-swarm year. Low rate, but a high share of fireballs.

items.title: Northern Taurids
items.verdict: ZHR ~5. Radiant up 22:52–04:37, highest 28° at 02:27, moonless. Active 10-13 – 12-02. Broad, shallow maximum; overlaps the Southern Taurids.
